title: 돈봉투
scene: 연애 1년. 유진 엄마가 따로 만나자고 했다. 고급 호텔 커피숍 — 드라마라면 「이 돈 받고 헤어져」 장면
kdrama: 애인 엄마의 「이 돈 받고 헤어져」 돈봉투
goal: Meeting a partner's parent — formal speech under pressure

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 네, 처음 뵙겠습니다. 유진 씨한테 말씀 많이 들었어요.
turns.rd: ne, cheoeum boepgetseumnida. yujin ssihante malsseum mani deureosseoyo.
turns.en: Yes, nice to meet you. I've heard a lot about you from Yujin.
turns.note: 얘기 많이 들었습니다 = I've heard a lot (about you)

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: You've been dating our Yujin for a year?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Yes. Next week is exactly one year.

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: I see. Then I'll get straight to the point.

turns.speaker: C
turns.note: she slides a white envelope across the table

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Wait. Don't tell me… you want me to break up with her?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: In dramas they hand over an envelope like this and say that.

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 어머, 드라마를 너무 많이 봤네요. 열어 보세요.
turns.rd: eomeo, deuramareul neomu mani bwanneyo. yeoreo boseyo.
turns.en: Oh my, you've watched too many dramas. Open it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.note: Kick: the envelope is a gift

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: It's your first anniversary, isn't it. Our Yujin loves couple tees.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Oh… thank you. Really, thank you so much.

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 그럼 됐어요. 대신 우리 딸 울리면 그땐 진짜 봉투예요.
turns.rd: geureom dwaesseoyo. daesin uri ttal ullimyeon geuttaen jinjja bongtuyeyo.
turns.en: Then we're good. But if you make my daughter cry, then it's a real envelope.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: …Of course. I'll never make her cry.
